title: Ecommerce Executive
company: Fine Fair Garments Trading Company (Kair Fashion)
description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented
 **Ecommerce Executive** 
 to manage and grow our online sales channels. The candidate will be responsible for product listing, catalog management, marketplace operations, online promotions, advertising campaigns, order coordination, and ecommerce performance tracking.
 



 Experience in
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra,Meesho,** 
 etc is preferred. Knowledge of
 **Meta Ads and Google Ads** 
 will be an added advantage.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Marketplace Management** 



* Manage product listings and catalogs across
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and Meesho** 
 , etc..
* Create and optimize product titles, descriptions, bullet points, keywords, attributes, size charts, and other product information.
* Upload and manage product images according to marketplace guidelines.
* Manage product SKUs, pricing, MRP, inventory, size/variant mapping, and product availability.
* Monitor and resolve listing errors, suppressed listings, catalog issues, and product attribute issues.
* Ensure all products are properly categorized and optimized for marketplace search.



**Marketplace Advertising** 



* Create, manage, and optimize
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and Meesho advertising campaigns** 
 .
* Monitor campaign performance, ad spend, sales, ROAS, ACOS, CPC, CTR, and conversions.
* Perform keyword research and optimize marketplace campaigns.
* Identify high\-performing products and keywords and improve campaign performance accordingly.



**Ecommerce Operations** 



* Monitor daily orders, cancellations, returns, refunds, and RTOs.
* Coordinate with warehouse and operations teams for order processing and dispatch.
* Monitor stock availability and coordinate for inventory updates.
* Track marketplace sales and identify opportunities to improve revenue.
* Maintain daily/weekly ecommerce reports and performance dashboards.



**Required Skills** 



* Experience with
 **Amazon Seller Central** 
 ,
 **Flipkart Seller Hub** 
 ,
 **Myntra Partner Portal, etc..**
* Product listing and catalog management, SKU and inventory management
* Marketplace advertising
* Basic understanding of ecommerce analytics
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Strong attention to detail



**Preferred / Added Advantage** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 **Meta Ads** 
 \&
 **Google Ads**
* Knowledge of Google Analytics / GA4
* Understanding of ecommerce conversion optimization
* Knowledge of SEO and marketplace SEO
* Experience in fashion/apparel ecommerce



**Qualification** 




 Any Degree / Diploma with relevant experience in Ecommerce, Marketplace Management, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
 



**Experience** 




**1–3 years of relevant experience** 
 in Ecommerce / Marketplace Management.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Summary** 




 The AI Data Analyst will design, develop, document, and maintain data pipelines and architectures, workingclosely with IT, Data Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver artificial intelligence and machine learningsolutions. Provide technical support on selected AI systems (for example, Generative AI applications, agenticworkflows, and internal data integration tools) and participate in enterprise IT and AI projects.
 



  





**Detailed Description** 




 Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
 


* Collaborate with IT and Data Science teams to gather technical requirements, ensuring data availability and system readiness for AI integration.
* Design, build, and optimize data pipelines (ETL/ELT) to prepare, clean, and structure datasets for machine learning models and large language models (LLMs).
* Work within Google Cloud environments to manage datasets, orchestrate data flows, and support model deployment.
* Respond to system, API, and data pipeline problems by troubleshooting data anomalies, analyzing logs, and determining the technical course of action.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for data architectures, API integrations, and AI workflows.
* Participate in the configuration, testing, and deployment of agentic AI development and workflow orchestration platforms.



**Knowledge/Skills/Competencies** 



* Strong technical collaboration and teamwork skills within an IT environment.
* Good analytical, technical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good technical documentation skills, including mapping technical architectures, data pipelines, and system integrations.
* Good understanding of data engineering concepts, database management, and the IT software development life cycle.
* Proficient coding skills in Python (including data libraries like Pandas and NumPy) and robust SQL skills for complex database querying and data manipulation.
* Understanding of core machine learning concepts and familiarity with Generative AI tools, agentic development, and AI orchestration platforms (e.g., Flowise AI, Zapier, n8n).
* Familiarity with Google Cloud data and AI technologies, specificallyGemini, BigQuery, and Vertex AI
* Understanding of interrelations between IT infrastructure components (cloud environments, APIs, databases, data pipelines, servers, etc.).



  





**Physical Demands** 



* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.



**Experience** 



* A minimum of three years of professional experience is required.
* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in similar roles



**Education** 




 15 years of full time education is mandatory.
 



  





**Notes** 




 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for anyfunction are subject to change at any time.
